selected_scenarios.5: 5A: failed A does not cancel preselected B; A rejoins next cycle with original age
selected_scenarios.6: 6B: forward successful grants into the current oldest-five window
selected_scenarios.10: 10B: allow same-cycle response retirement and AR allocation/reuse

window_blocking.scope: Oldest five not-yet-successfully-issued commands, before filtering bank availability
window_blocking.scenario_11: If all five window commands remain bank-busy and there is no issue-stage success, an idle-bank sixth command stays outside the window and cannot issue
window_blocking.window_advance: 6B forwards actual successful issue only; allocation, MEM completion and R retirement do not by themselves advance this pending-command window

allocation_logic: free_mask = ~valid | retire_mask; allocation initialization wins on reused entry

capacity_policy.user_requirement: Prevent one XAU from exhausting entries and denying entry admission to other XAUs
capacity_policy.supersedes: Unrestricted sharing with no per-XAU admission protection
capacity_policy.design_choice: One logical reserved entry per XAU plus six shared entries; nine physical entries remain pooled
capacity_policy.policy_origin: Design recommendation implementing the new user requirement; reserve size not separately specified by user
capacity_policy.occupancy: All accepted commands until their R response retires, including issued and completed commands
capacity_policy.ready: After subtracting same-cycle retirement: free_after > 0 && (occ_after[x] == 0 || sum(max(occ_after[y]-1,0)) < 6)
capacity_policy.upstream_dependency: User confirmed shared AR may switch src; fairness remains unspecified. Eventual admission needs fairness; cmdbuf_rd guarantees capacity availability

mem_to_r_timing.eligibility: Only registered OTB completion from a previous cycle can enter R arbitration; per-XAU head order, current rready and RR must also permit the response
mem_to_r_timing.example: Successful issue C3 -> MEM capture C7 -> earliest R response C8

still_unconfirmed: Shared upstream AR arbitration fairness is unspecified; source switching is confirmed allowed
